title: EffectiveCommunicationInput
description: Input for communication effectiveness analysis of a meeting transcript. Supports two modes: transcript-only (broad coaching scan) or transcript + context (targeted coaching with user identity, communication goal, and focus areas). All optional fields improve coaching specificity when provided.

transcript.description: Full meeting transcript text. Must include enough dialogue for meaningful communication analysis (minimum 150 characters). Speaker-attributed transcripts produce higher-quality coaching output.

meeting_title.description: Title or subject of the meeting. Helps contextualize communication dynamics. Example: 'Q3 Budget Review — Executive Committee'.

meeting_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime of when the meeting occurred.

user_name.description: Name of the person being coached. When provided, analysis focuses on this person's communication patterns, strengths, and improvement areas.

communication_goal.description: The primary communication objective the user had for this meeting. Shapes the coaching lens. Examples: 'align', 'persuade', 'decide', 'unblock'.

audience_context.description: Background on the audience — seniority, familiarity with topic, known concerns. Helps calibrate audience-alignment scoring.

tone_target.description: Desired communication tone. 'neutral' = balanced and professional. 'warm' = empathetic and collaborative. 'assertive' = direct and decisive. 'executive' = crisp, high-signal, time-aware.

analysis_depth.description: Controls analysis thoroughness. 'quick' = headline-level coaching. 'standard' = balanced analysis with rewrites. 'deep' = comprehensive analysis with extended missed-opportunity coverage and detailed drills.

participant_directory.description: Known meeting participants to improve speaker attribution and audience-alignment analysis.

name.description: Full name of the participant as they appear in the transcript.

role.description: Job title or organizational role. Example: 'VP Engineering', 'Product Lead'.

team.description: Team, department, or business unit. Example: 'Platform', 'Product', 'Finance'.

focus_areas.description: Specific communication dimensions to prioritize in the analysis. When provided, these areas receive deeper coverage in priority_improvements.

key_questions.description: Specific questions the user wants answered about their communication. Maximum 8 questions.
